# Archive as Design Employee — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-157996
Voiceover: A less-remembered house remains researchable because its object record survives.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Gift of Marion Litchfield, 1950

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CA02-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · RETRIEVE — Can the right record be found?. Identifiers, dates, makers, materials, controlled vocabulary, file relationships, and search pathways determine whether memory is available at the moment of decision.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA02-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · READ — Can someone understand why it matters?. A sketch, fitting note, failed sample, or garment becomes more useful when the record preserves the question it answered—not only what it looks like.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA02-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · TRANSFORM — Can the archive generate difference?. The strongest use is not literal revival. It is recovery of a method, constraint, construction problem, or unresolved question that can be recomposed for a new context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA02-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CITE — Can the new work show its lineage?. Source identifiers, rights decisions, credits, and transformation notes let inspiration remain accountable. Citation does not weaken originality; it distinguishes research from extraction.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
